---
title: Validation instructions when submitting to validate state
value: "A lot of tasks get completed but their acceptance critera depend on the user testing something, for matters of taste that cant be verified subjectively. Our model should work with this fact and make it easy for the user to confirm they were completed as intended, so we should have a way to leave some testing/verification instructions on the task itself so that it's self contained and can be picked up easily by the user later. Can build this into the cli verb for delivering it. Not all tasks should require this step, and if they do it should be noted at least by the time they are sent to implementation. Trying to deliver such a task should ask for the verification instructions so it cant be bypassed\x05"
